dedupe_keys.name: ハス路線情報 gtfs jp bus and public transit

description: バス路線情報(GTFS-JP) [bus and public transit] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 豊岡市. 豊岡市のコミュニティバス（コバス・イナカ―）のバス情報フォーマット（GTFS-JP）形式データになります。. Coverage: 豊岡市. The portal files it under the publisher 豊岡市. Its tags are コミュニティバス. It offers 4 resource(s) in zip. The portal shows 2026-03-04 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
